paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: : (a) The impact of hyperparameter N on F1 score. (b) The impact of hyperparameter N on AUC.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the impact of the hyperparameter N on the AUC (Area Under the Curve) metric, expressed as a percentage, across different models or configurations. The x-axis represents the hyperparameter N, ranging from 0 to 20 with linear spacing and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis denotes AUC (%) and spans from 75% to 100%, also with linear spacing and tick marks at 5% intervals. Five distinct lines, each marked with a unique symbol and color, represent different models or settings. The blue line with circular markers starts at approximately 95% AUC at N=0, rises to a peak of about 99% at N=5, then gradually declines to around 95% at N=20. The red line with square markers begins at about 87% at N=0, increases to roughly 99% at N=10, and then decreases to approximately 91% at N=20. The orange line with diamond markers starts at 84% at N=0, rises to about 94% at N=5, and remains relatively flat, ending near 95% at N=20. The green line with star markers begins at 86% at N=0, increases steadily to around 94% at N=20. The purple line with inverted triangular markers starts at 80% at N=0, remains flat until N=5, then sharply increases to a peak of approximately 95% at N=10, before dropping to about 82% at N=20.
